scenes.tts: Adding the source is half the case. What happens if you take it away?
scenes.visual: Visual language: one flat strip of neural tube, front at left; slate Otx2, sage Gbx2, gold Fgf8, clay Wnt1. Title card: Started, Then Lost. Icon: take it away.
scenes.narration: Adding the source is half the case. What happens if you take it away?

scenes.tts: In the mouse, gene targeting can remove one gene. The change is made in embryonic stem cells.
scenes.visual: A gene diagram with one segment crossed out, then a dish of embryonic stem cells, then a mouse outline.
scenes.narration: In the mouse, gene targeting can remove one gene. The change is made in embryonic stem cells.

scenes.tts: Wint one is made in a ring just in front of the line. Mice lacking it lose most of the midbrain and much of the cerebellum.
scenes.caption: Wnt1 is made in a ring just in front of the line. Mice lacking it lose most of the midbrain and much of the cerebellum.
scenes.visual: The clay Wnt1 ring at the line, crossed out. Credits: McMahon and Bradley; Thomas and Capecchi, 1990. A brain outline with most of the midbrain and much of the cerebellum faded.
scenes.narration: Wnt1 is made in a ring just in front of the line. Mice lacking it lose most of the midbrain and much of the cerebellum.

scenes.tts: Predict. In these mice, does Engrailed never come on? Or does it come on, and then fade?
scenes.visual: Two blank time-course panels, wild type and Wnt1 null, three time points each. Question card: never on, or on and then fade?
scenes.narration: Predict. In these mice, does Engrailed never come on? Or does it come on, and then fade?

scenes.tts: Engrailed comes on. Then it is lost, and the tissue disappears. Wint one is needed to keep Engrailed on, not to turn it on.
scenes.caption: Engrailed comes on. Then it is lost, and the tissue disappears. Wnt1 is needed to keep Engrailed on, not to turn it on.
scenes.visual: Schematic, not data. Wild type: Engrailed blue on, and stays on, at all three time points. Wnt1 null: on, then fading, then the tissue gone.
scenes.narration: Engrailed comes on. Then it is lost, and the tissue disappears. Wnt1 is needed to keep Engrailed on, not to turn it on.

scenes.tts: Call this signature started, then lost.
scenes.visual: Label across the mutant panels: started, then lost.
scenes.narration: Call this signature started, then lost.

scenes.tts: So supplying Engrailed should help. In nineteen ninety-six, Danielian and McMahon made Engrailed one from Wint one's own control elements, in the mutants. Early development of the region was restored.
scenes.caption: So supplying Engrailed should help. In 1996, Danielian and McMahon made En1 from Wnt1's own control elements, in the mutants. Early development of the region was restored.
scenes.visual: Engrailed blue is placed back into the Wnt1 domain from Wnt1's own control elements; the midbrain and anterior hindbrain outlines return. Credit: Danielian and McMahon, 1996.
scenes.narration: So supplying Engrailed should help. In 1996, Danielian and McMahon made En1 from Wnt1's own control elements, in the mutants. Early development of the region was restored.

scenes.tts: A signal keeps a transcription factor on. The transcription factor keeps the territory.
scenes.visual: Two chips joined by an arrow: Wnt1 to Engrailed, and Engrailed to territory.
scenes.narration: A signal keeps a transcription factor on. The transcription factor keeps the territory.

scenes.tts: F G F eight gives the same signature. In acerebellar, a zebrafish F G F eight mutant, boundary genes switch on, and then fade.
scenes.caption: FGF8 gives the same signature. In acerebellar, a zebrafish FGF8 mutant, boundary genes switch on, and then fade.
scenes.visual: A zebrafish outline labelled acerebellar, Fgf8 mutant. Boundary-gene time course: on, then fading.
scenes.narration: FGF8 gives the same signature. In acerebellar, a zebrafish FGF8 mutant, boundary genes switch on, and then fade.

scenes.tts: Mice that lose F G F eight early from the region lack midbrain and cerebellum. Milder reductions spare part of both.
scenes.caption: Mice that lose FGF8 early from the region lack midbrain and cerebellum. Milder reductions spare part of both.
scenes.visual: Two mouse brain outlines. Left, labelled early regional Fgf8 deletion: midbrain and cerebellum outlines absent. Right, labelled milder Fgf8 reduction: the front of the midbrain and the sides of the cerebellum kept.
scenes.narration: Mice that lose FGF8 early from the region lack midbrain and cerebellum. Milder reductions spare part of both.

scenes.tts: In these two mutants, the program does not fail to start. It fails to last.
scenes.visual: The two time courses side by side: Wnt1 null and acerebellar, both started, then lost.
scenes.narration: In these two mutants, the program does not fail to start. It fails to last.

scenes.tts: So the signals are needed to keep the program running. In the standard model, built on other experiments too, the transcription factors help keep the signals on. Remove a key part, and the rest fade.
scenes.visual: The loop inset assembles chip by chip: Fgf8 and Wnt1 chips, then the Engrailed and Pax chip. The arrow from Wnt1 to Engrailed is solid (the rescue); the return arrows to the signals are dashed (other experiments). One chip is removed and the others dim. Label: standard model; schematic, not a wiring diagram.
scenes.narration: So the signals are needed to keep the program running. In the standard model, built on other experiments too, the transcription factors help keep the signals on. Remove a key part, and the rest fade.

scenes.tts: So the source has been tested three ways. Move it, add it, and take it away.
scenes.visual: Three test icons: move it, add it, take it away.
scenes.narration: So the source has been tested three ways. Move it, add it, and take it away.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: a line becomes a source. It must stay on long enough for each part. Remove it too early, and parts are lost or changed.
scenes.visual: Closing card: A line becomes a source, and it must stay on long enough.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: a line becomes a source. It must stay on long enough for each part. Remove it too early, and parts are lost or changed.
